excerpt: Download Ellis – In-Person AI Notes by Nectar Labs UG (haftungsbeschränk) on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like…
content_html:
When meetings happen in a room

Free · In‑App Purchases · Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS.

Ellis is an AI notetaker for in-person meetings, not over Zoom. Built for people, where being in the same room matters. Perfect for conferences, coffee meetups, therapy sessions, face-to-face sales meetings, interviews, or on-site research sessions. You can stay present, and capture your interactions all in one tap. Ellis automatically transcribes your meeting, helps you tag your own voice as speaker, and writes elegant notes you can share: simple summaries, or one focused on outcomes, process, or how you came across. In-person meetings are worth keeping. They're more honest than a screen, and they go deeper. Ellis is built to learn from them. SINLGE-TAP CAPTURE - Use Lock Screen or Home Screen widgets for faster access - Pause / resume / complete – just like your favorite fitness activity app ASK ELLIS - Ask anything about a specific meeting - Ask about your personal progress between multiple meetings - Get insights on decisions made, who spoke how much, and what you can do differently next time as a speaker - Ask for information based on where it was recorded, e.g. "what did the recruiter in Brooklyn say about leadership?" HOW IT WORKS - Start a new meeting recording from the Lock Screen or Home Page widget, or in the app - The recording is deleted once its transcribed - Tag your own voice by tapping a quote - Share notes or keep them private - Chat with your notes per recording, or ask general questions beyond a single meeting. - Type or talk to Ellis Try Ellis for your next in-person meetings today. It's free to get started. Take as many notes as you'd like. Upgrade to view and work with notes older than one week. Questions? Email Robin, who built Ellis: robin@ellis.coach Privacy Policy: https://ellis.coach/privacy FAQ: https://www.ellis.coach/faq Terms of use: https://www.ellis.coach/terms

content_html_zh:
当会议在房间内举行时

免费 · 应用内购买 · 专为 iPad 设计。 未针对 macOS 进行验证。

埃利斯是一名人工智能笔记员，用于现场会议，而不是通过 Zoom。 专为人们而设计，在同一个房间里很重要。 非常适合会议、咖啡聚会、治疗会议、面对面销售会议、采访或现场研究会议。 您可以保持在场，一键捕捉您的互动。 埃利斯会自动转录您的会议，帮助您将自己的声音标记为发言者，并编写可供分享的优雅笔记：简单的摘要，或专注于结果、过程或您的感受的笔记。 面对面的会议值得保留。 它们比屏幕更诚实，而且更深入。 埃利斯就是为了向他们学习而生的。 单击捕获 - 使用锁屏或主屏幕小部件实现更快的访问 - 暂停/恢复/完成 - 就像您最喜爱的健身活动应用程序 ASK ELLIS - 询问有关特定会议的任何信息 - 询问多次会议之间的个人进度 - 深入了解所做的决定、谁发言了多少，以及下次作为演讲者可以采取哪些不同的做法 - 根据记录位置询问信息，例如“布鲁克林的招聘人员对领导力有何评价？” 工作原理 - 从锁定屏幕或主页小部件或应用程序中开始新的会议录音 - 录音一旦转录就会被删除 - 通过点击引言来标记您自己的声音 - 共享笔记或将其保密 - 根据录音与您的笔记聊天，或提出单次会议之外的一般问题。 - 键入或与 Ellis 交谈 今天尝试 Ellis 参加您的下一次面对面会议。 开始使用是免费的。 记下尽可能多的笔记。 升级后即可查看和处理超过一周的笔记。 问题？ 向 Ellis 的创建者 Robin 发送电子邮件：robin@ellis.coach 隐私政策：https://ellis.coach/privacy 常见问题解答：https://www.ellis.coach/faq 使用条款：https://www.ellis.coach/terms
